info.name: EaaS Platform API
info.description:
Escrow-as-a-Service platform API collection.
Base URL: http://localhost:8080 (API Gateway)

Three user roles are supported (simultaneous login):
  - Admin: admin@eaas.com / Admin@123
  - Customer: customer@example.com / Customer@123
  - Merchant: merchant@example.com / Merchant@123

Register Customer and Merchant first via the Auth folder, then login each role.
Admin user must be created via create_admin_user.sql first.
